sources.title: Dark AI: Exploring the Shadows of Artificial Intelligence - Snyk
sources.snippet: What is dark AI? Dark AI is the malicious use of artificial intelligence to develop cyberattacks, commit fraud, or execute other illicit activities. It is also on the rise. Generative AI (GenAI) has lowered the barrier to entry, making it easier for cybercriminals to design and launch attacks.
